messages:
ravi (product): Quick check-in on the operator-inbox flow for automatic fallback policies. Wanted to validate the UX story and what shows up in the audit/lineage.

sophia (eng-platform): Goal: let an operator see a proposed fallback, preview impact, ack it, or escalate. Audit should record immutable decisions with pointers to the policy and sample artifacts.

noah (sre): Needs to be easy to trace later: decision_id, policy_hash, trigger_snapshot (metric values), affected_routes, and a pointer to a sanitized sample request set.

carmen (ops): Operator UX requests: 1) one-click acknowledge, 2) quick "why" summary (metric delta + top traces), 3) ability to annotate the decision for oncall handoff.

sophia (eng-platform): Console proposal: inbox card shows: small header (mode, reason), timeline (preview -> dry-run -> active), buttons: Preview / Dry-run (sample X%) / Activate / Override. Preview expands to side-by-side sample responses + cost delta estimate.

ravi (product): We should name modes to avoid confusion: "observe" (dry-run sampling), "soft-route" (partial traffic), "restrict" (feature reduction), "safe-route" (full fallback).

noah (sre): Telemetry hooks: include X-Decision-Id in downstream requests. Emit metric: redwood_fallback_decisions_total{mode,trigger}. Also record a Gauge for active_fallbacks_by_route.

sophia (eng-platform): API sketch for activation response: `{"decision_id":"uuid","status":"preview|dry-run|active","preview_url":"/console/…","sample_rate":0.05}`. Header support on runtime will be fast follow.

carmen (ops): Two edge cases: stale preview (policy edited after preview) and multiple operators acking simultaneously. We need immutable decisions and a simple link to the policy version used. Also show diff between policy versions in the inbox.

sophia (eng-platform): Immutable decision model: each activation stores {decision_id, policy_version, href_to_config_blob, created_by, created_at, trigger_snapshot}. Overrides create a new decision that references prior_decision_id. All immutable.

ravi (product): For audit retention: default 180 days, exportable JSON lines for legal/forensics. We must scrub PII in preview snapshots automatically.

noah (sre): Auto-rollback: prefer human escalation by default. Add a policy flag: `auto_rollback: {enabled: true, failures: 3}`. If enabled, runtime creates rollback decision with link to original decision id.

sophia (eng-platform): Example policy block for console editing (YAML):

```yaml
name: auto-fallback-playbook-2026
triggers:
  - name: p95_latency
    metric: latency_p95_ms
    threshold: 1500
    window: 3m
    hysteresis: 60s
    sample_on_preview: 0.02
sequence:
  - mode: observe
    duration: 10m
  - mode: soft-route
    percentage: 20
    escalate_after: 15m
  - mode: safe-route
    duration: 24h
audit:
  retention_days: 180
  scrub_preview: true
  include_fields: [decision_id, policy_version, trigger_snapshot, affected_routes]
auto_rollback:
  enabled: false
  failures: 3
```

carmen (ops): Nice. For the inbox modal, include a compact timeline and a small freeform note field that gets appended to the audit event. Operators can click "ack & annotate".

sophia (eng-platform): Implementation notes: store config blob in object store with SHA256 as policy_version. Preview snapshots are stored encrypted and referenced by audit events; scrubber runs before storage. Runtime will accept X-Decision-Id and log it into traces.

ravi (product): Product ask: display estimated cost impact (delta tokens / gpu-hours) in the preview. Even rough numbers help ops decide.

noah (sre): We'll add a Grafana panel: "Fallbacks by route" + quick link from decision to recent traces. Also record fallback_outcomes_total{decision_id,result} for later rollout analysis.

sophia (eng-platform): Deployment note: API PR for decision header + activation payload will go to staging. I'll include example webhook for alerting when a decision becomes active.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: sophia/eng-platform pushed branch fallback-inbox-v0 -> staging at 2026-03-24T09:42:11Z

carmen (ops): Action items: I'll wire up the inbox mock, add annotate UI, and demo to ops next Wednesday.

sophia (eng-platform): I'll create a minimal spec doc with the event schema and sample events. Expect a link in #docs later today.

ravi (product): Perfect. Let's reconvene after staging smoke tests. Thanks everyone :tada!
